- * Mastery of Premiere Pro or CapCut
- * Familiarity with After Effects
- * Mastery of Canva
- * Familiarity with ChatGPT for content generation
- * Familiarity with AI tools for image and video generation
- * Ability to create short and viral content for social media
- It is considered an advantage:
- * Experience in the tourism or migration industry
- * Familiarity with Instagram content creation and its algorithms
- * Familiarity with SEO and website content creation

- * Number of content produced per month
- * Content quality and engagement rate
- * Adherence to project scheduling
- * Number of leads generated through content

Job description:
Niayesir Tourism Company invites creative individuals proficient in design tools and artificial intelligence to cooperate in the development of digital marketing activities and professional content production. Responsibilities: * Design of posts, stories, and advertising banners * Production and editing of promotional videos for Instagram, YouTube, and website * Creation of professional Reels in the fields of tourism, immigration, and foreign tours * Use of artificial intelligence tools to increase the speed and quality of content production * Designing short advertising scenarios * Collaboration with the marketing team for executing advertising campaigns Required skills: * Proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator * Proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut * Familiarity with After Effects * Proficiency in Canva * Familiarity with ChatGPT for content generation * Familiarity with AI tools for image and video generation * Ability to create short and viral content for social media is an advantage: * Experience in the tourism or immigration industry * Familiarity with Instagram content production and its algorithms * Familiarity with SEO and website content production Performance Indicators (KPIs): * Number of pieces of content produced per month * Quality and engagement rate of content * Adherence to project timelines * Number of leads generated through content * Amount of use of AI tools to increase efficiency Please send your resume and portfolio.

Company description:
Nayesh Sir company started its activities in the tourism industry from the year 1382 and has been able to shine in various arenas of this industry during these years. It has always strived towards its goals, namely providing quality services to customers and improving the quality level of the group and personnel. Also, in these years, relying on the younger generation, it has always been pursuing progress and applying new ideas in this industry and transferring experiences to the new generation.
